description: Host a Nomads.com meetup as the member: it is posted in the community chat, members in that city then get notified, and at 2 RSVPs it is also shared in the country channel and on X. Authenticated as the member (signed in through the connector with OAuth or an Authorization header, or username + personal key from https://nomads.com/settings). The member needs a profile photo and Telegram connected. Ask the member to confirm the details before calling this, it is posted publicly.

city_slug.description: From search_cities or get_city, e.g. lisbon-portugal

description.description: What you will do. No paid tickets or selling

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

recurrence.description: Optional: repeat every week (same weekday) or every month (same nth weekday)

time.description: Local start time as a whole hour, e.g. 19 or 19:00

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

venue.description: Name of the cafe, bar or restaurant

name: create_meetup
